attributes.magic: PE32 executable (GUI) Intel 80386, for MS Windows

crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The sample is the legitimate Microsoft HTML Help Executable (`hh.exe`). It loads the HTML Help control library `hhctrl.ocx`, retrieves the address of the `doWinMain` function, and executes it. The program also checks the registry for a policy to disable Data Execution Prevention (`HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System\DisableHHDEP`) by calling `SetProcessDEPPolicy`, which is a known legitimate compatibility feature of this executable. No malicious behaviors were identified.
